Donald Trump's popularity rebounded slightly in this week's Economist / YouGov Poll after his recent slump, but he remains deeply unpopular. This week's poll finds that 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, and 57% disapprove — a net job approval of -21. That's an improvement for Trump from the week before, when 35% approved and 61% disapproved for a net approval of -26. results.content: A new Economist/YouGov poll, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump's job performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025. [...] The Economist/YouGov poll also found that 60% of Americans view the president as "not honest and trustworthy." Trump's age continues to concern many Americans, with 53% saying they believe the 80-year-old president is too old to serve in the White House. Additionally, 69% said they feel that things in the country are "out of control."

# Trump poll finds most states disapprove of his job performance

Portrait of Natassia Paloma

Most states disapprove of President Donald Trump’s job performance, including Texas.

According to an approval tracker from The Economist and YouGov, Trump’s net job approval rating in Texas is -22, meaning his disapproval rating is 22 percentage points higher than his approval rating.

Texas is far from alone.
